verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe custom dashboards over cost, latency, volume, and quality/eval-score metrics, plus a Metrics API v2 for querying aggregate cost, usage, latency, volume, or score metrics, and alerting on thresholds—directly matching the story. Community feedback corroborates strength in cost/latency/quality observability workflows, though no independent hands-on review of the dashboard builder itself is present.
